<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow, noarchive">
<meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">
<title>Atrium — Operations</title>
<!-- Inter loads without blocking first paint: the stylesheet arrives as media="print" (fetched at low
     priority, never render-blocking) and app.js boot() flips it to media="all" — no inline handler,
     so the page does not lean on script-src 'unsafe-inline' for it; with scripts off the plain link
     applies. The system stack in --font paints in the meantime, so a blocked fonts.googleapis.com costs nothing. -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" media="print" data-font-swap>
<noscript><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap"></noscript>
<!-- Front desk shell. Sources live in ops/src/ and are composed by `npm run build:ops`:
     each @include line becomes the file wrapped in <style> / <script>. The include order is
     the contract's: styles, calendar, leads, calls (CSS), then app, calls, calendar, leads (JS).
     app.js boots on DOMContentLoaded after every module has registered — no inline boot call. -->
<style>
/* Front desk — shell styles. Owner: shell. Tokens, reset, layout, and every shared
   component class the modules use (brief §3, §4). Dark values live once under
   prefers-color-scheme; every colour on the page comes from these tokens. */

:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --paper: #F3F6FB; --paper-2: #FFFFFF; --paper-3: #EAF0F8;
  --ink: #14233E; --ink-2: #50617B; --ink-3: #60718A;
  --line: #DFE6F0; --line-strong: #C6D2E2; --line-ctrl: #96A8C0;
  --accent: #245CD4; --accent-strong: #1848AF; --accent-soft: #EAF1FF; --on-accent: #FFFFFF;
  --ok: #147452; --ok-soft: #E7F5EF; --ok-line: #9ED4BD;
  --warn: #8A5109; --warn-soft: #FFF4DF; --danger: #B33143; --danger-soft: #FDECEF;
  --blocked: #66758D; --blocked-soft: #EDF1F7; --blocked-stripe: #DFE6F0;
  --lost: #715384; --lost-soft: #F1ECF7; --info: #245CB2; --info-soft: #EAF2FF;
  --focus: #245CD4; --scrim: rgba(11, 27, 53, .42);
  --shadow-pop: 0 18px 56px rgba(16, 39, 76, .16), 0 2px 8px rgba(16, 39, 76, .06);
  --s1: 4px; --s2: 8px; --s3: 12px; --s4: 16px; --s5: 24px; --s6: 32px; --s7: 48px;
  --r-ctrl: 8px; --r-card: 14px; --r-sheet: 18px;
  --ctrl-h: 40px; --side-w: 244px; --main-pad: 36px;
  --font: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --motion: 140ms;
}
/* The base size sits here, above the mobile block, so the 15 px mobile rule (same specificity,
   later in the sheet) wins as the brief's §3.2 intends. */
/* overscroll-behavior-x: none — the calendar's own left/right swipe pages the agenda; the browser must
   never read the same gesture as history navigation and drop the person out of the page. */
html { font-size: 16px; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; overscroll-behavior-x: none; }
@media (max-width: 959px) {
  :root { --ctrl-h: 44px; --main-pad: 16px; }
  html { font-size: 16px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    transition-duration: .01ms !important;
    animation-duration: .01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

/* ---------- reset and base ---------- */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.43;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overscroll-behavior-x: none;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
::selection { background: var(--accent-soft); }
h1, h2, h3, h4, p, ul, ol, dl, dd, figure { margin: 0; }
h1 { font-size: 1.714rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; }
h2 { font-size: 1.286rem; line-height: 1.33; font-weight: 600; }
h3 { font-size: 1.071rem; line-height: 1.33; font-weight: 600; }
h1:focus, h2:focus { outline: none; }
a { color: var(--accent); }
a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
svg { flex: none; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
details > summary { cursor: pointer; }
details > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* type steps */
.display { font-size: 2.286rem; line-height: 1.125; font-weight: 600; }
.label { font-size: .929rem; line-height: 1.385; font-weight: 600; }
.small { font-size: .929rem; line-height: 1.385; }
.caption { font-size: .857rem; line-height: 1.333; font-weight: 500; }
.strong { font-weight: 500; }
.prose { max-width: 68ch; }

/* utilities */
.vh { position: absolute !important; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.num, .badge, .chip, .big-number-value, .cal-gutter { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.muted { color: var(--ink-2); }
.faint { color: var(--ink-3); }
.stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--s2); }
.cluster { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--s2); }
.link { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }
.link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.ico { display: inline-flex; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: -.15em; }
.ico svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.ok-text { color: var(--ok); }
.warn-text { color: var(--warn); }
.danger-text { color: var(--danger); }

/* ---------- layout: sidebar / top bar / tab bar ---------- */
.skip {
  position: absolute; left: -999px; top: 8px; z-index: 100;
  padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--paper-2); color: var(--accent);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-ctrl); border-radius: var(--r-ctrl); text-decoration: none;
}
.skip:focus { left: 8px; }

.side {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: var(--side-w); z-index: 20;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  padding: 20px 12px 16px;
  background: var(--paper-3); border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.brand { padding: 4px 12px 16px; }
.brand-name { display: block; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; }
.brand-sub { display: block; font-size: .857rem; color: var(--ink-3); }
.brand-date { display: block; font-size: .857rem; color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 2px; }
.brand-view { display: none; }

.nav ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.nav-item {
  position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--r-ctrl);
  color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;
}
.nav-item:hover { background: var(--line); text-decoration: none; }
.nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.nav-item[aria-current="page"]::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent);
}
.nav-icon { display: inline-flex; position: relative; }
.nav-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.nav-label { flex: 1; }
.badge {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: .786rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1;
  background: var(--paper-2); color: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.badge-warn { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); border-color: transparent; }
.badge-danger { background: var(--danger); color: var(--on-accent); border-color: transparent; }
.nav-dot { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--warn); }

.side-foot { margin-top: auto; padding: 12px 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.cluster-link { display: block; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.cluster-link:hover { text-decoration: none; }
.cluster-link:hover .cluster-l1 { text-decoration: underline; }
.cluster-desk { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }
.cluster-desk .ico { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-top: 2px; }
.cluster-l1 { display: block; font-size: .929rem; font-weight: 500; }
.cluster-l2 { display: block; font-size: .857rem; color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 2px; }
.cluster-mobile { display: none; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: .857rem; font-weight: 500; }
.cluster-mobile .ico { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.cluster-warn .cluster-l1, .cluster-warn .ico, .cluster-warn.cluster-mobile { color: var(--warn); }
.cluster-ok .ico { color: var(--ok); }
.staff-only { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: .857rem; color: var(--ink-3); text-decoration: none; }
.staff-only .ico { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

main { margin-left: var(--side-w); padding: var(--main-pad); min-height: 100vh; }
main:focus { outline: none; }
.view { max-width: 1120px; }
.view-head { margin-bottom: var(--s5); }
.view-head h1 { display: inline-block; }
.dateline { margin-top: 2px; }
.briefing { margin-top: 8px; max-width: 68ch; }
.global-banners:not(:empty) { margin-bottom: var(--s4); max-width: 1120px; }

@media (max-width: 959px) {
  .side {
    position: sticky; top: 0; bottom: auto; width: auto; height: 52px;
    flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 16px; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .brand { padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
  .brand-name { white-space: nowrap; }
  .brand-sub, .brand-date { display: none; }
  .brand-view { display: inline; color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 400; white-space: nowrap; }
  .nav {
    position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 20;
    height: calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
    background: var(--paper-3); border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav ul { flex-direction: row; height: 56px; gap: 0; }
  .nav li { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; }
  .nav-item {
    width: 100%; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px;
    height: 56px; padding: 0; border-radius: 0; border-top: 2px solid transparent;
    font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 500; /* 12 px at the 15 px base — the brief's caption floor */
  }
  .nav-item:hover { background: transparent; }
  .nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: transparent; border-top-color: var(--accent); }
  .nav-item[aria-current="page"]::before { display: none; }
  .nav-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .nav-item .badge { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: calc(50% + 6px); }
  .nav-item .nav-dot { position: absolute; top: 8px; left: calc(50% + 8px); }
  .side-foot { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; }
  /* The status link in the top bar is a 44 px tall target; the bar is 52 px, so it fits. */
  .cluster-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
  .staff-only { display: none; }
  .cluster-desk { display: none; }
  .cluster-mobile { display: inline-flex; }
  main { margin-left: 0; padding: var(--main-pad); padding-bottom: calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); min-height: 0; }
}

/* ---------- buttons ---------- */
/* Controls whose border is the only thing that marks them (buttons, fields, the segmented
   control, filter chips) use --line-ctrl, which clears 3:1 on white and paper (WCAG 1.4.11);
   --line and --line-strong stay for decorative hairlines: cards, grid lines, dividers. */
.btn, .btn-icon {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
  height: var(--ctrl-h); padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--r-ctrl);
  background: var(--paper-2); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line-ctrl);
  font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background var(--motion) ease-out, opacity var(--motion) ease-out;
}
.btn:hover, .btn-icon:hover { background: var(--paper-3); text-decoration: none; }
.btn .ico, .btn-icon .ico { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); border-color: transparent; }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong); }
.btn-quiet { background: transparent; border-color: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); }
.btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--paper-3); color: var(--ink); }
/* --on-accent on --danger reads in both themes (5.94 light, 7.13 dark); white on the dark salmon did not. */
.btn-danger { background: var(--danger); color: var(--on-accent); border-color: transparent; }
.btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger); filter: brightness(.92); }
.btn-link {
  display: inline; height: auto; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none;
  color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; white-space: normal; text-align: left;
}
.btn-link:hover { background: none; text-decoration: underline; }
.btn-icon { width: var(--ctrl-h); padding: 0; }
.btn-icon.btn-quiet { border-color: transparent; }
.btn[aria-disabled="true"], .btn-icon[aria-disabled="true"], .btn:disabled, .btn-icon:disabled, .btn-link[aria-disabled="true"], .chip-filter[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed;
}
.is-busy { position: relative; color: transparent !important; pointer-events: none; }
.is-busy > * { visibility: hidden; }
.is-busy::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: -8px 0 0 -8px;
  border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--line-strong); border-top-color: var(--ink-2);
  animation: spin .8s linear infinite;
}
.btn-primary.is-busy::after, .btn-danger.is-busy::after { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .35); border-top-color: var(--on-accent); }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.spin svg { animation: spin 1s linear infinite; }

/* ---------- chips ---------- */
.chip {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px;
  border-radius: 999px; font-size: .929rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap;
  background: var(--paper-3); color: var(--ink-2);
}
.chip .ico { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.chip-ok { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }
.chip-warn { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); }
.chip-danger { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }
.chip-blocked { background: var(--blocked-soft); color: var(--blocked); }
.chip-lost { background: var(--lost-soft); color: var(--lost); }
.chip-info { background: var(--info-soft); color: var(--info); }
.chip-neutral { background: var(--paper-3); color: var(--ink-2); }
.chip-filter {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: var(--r-ctrl); background: var(--paper-2); border: 1px solid var(--line-ctrl);
  color: var(--ink); font-size: .929rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background var(--motion) ease-out;
}
.chip-filter .ico { width: 14px; height: 14px; display: none; }
.chip-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.chip-filter[aria-pressed="true"] .ico { display: inline-flex; }
.chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
@media (max-width: 959px) { .chip-filter { height: 44px; } }

/* ---------- cards, rows, sections ---------- */
.card { background: var(--paper-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: var(--s4); }
.card-warn { border-left: 3px solid var(--warn); background: var(--warn-soft); }
.card-danger { border-left: 3px solid var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); }
.card-demo { border: 2px solid var(--warn); }
.card.rows { padding: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.card.rows > .row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.card-warn.rows > .row, .card-danger.rows > .row { background: transparent; }
/* A bordered button on a tinted card: --line-ctrl was chosen for 3:1 on white and paper, and on the
   amber / red soft fills it drops to ~2.8:1, so the border takes the card's own colour (≥ 4.7:1).
   Buttons whose border is transparent by design (primary, quiet, danger, link) stay that way. */
.card-warn .btn, .banner-warn .btn, .status-summary.is-warn .btn { border-color: var(--warn); }
.card-danger .btn, .banner-danger .btn { border-color: var(--danger); }
.card-warn .btn-primary, .card-warn .btn-quiet, .card-warn .btn-danger, .card-warn .btn-link,
.banner-warn .btn-primary, .banner-warn .btn-quiet, .banner-warn .btn-danger, .banner-warn .btn-link,
.status-summary.is-warn .btn-primary, .status-summary.is-warn .btn-quiet,
.card-danger .btn-primary, .card-danger .btn-quiet, .card-danger .btn-danger, .card-danger .btn-link,
.banner-danger .btn-primary, .banner-danger .btn-quiet, .banner-danger .btn-danger, .banner-danger .btn-link { border-color: transparent; }

.row {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; column-gap: 12px; row-gap: 6px; align-items: start;
  padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--paper-2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  min-height: 48px; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: inherit; text-decoration: none;
  transition: opacity var(--motion) ease-out, background var(--motion) ease-out;
}
.row:first-child { border-top-left-radius: inherit; border-top-right-radius: inherit; }
.row:last-child { border-bottom-left-radius: inherit; border-bottom-right-radius: inherit; }
button.row { border-left: 0; border-right: 0; border-top: 0; font: inherit; }
.row-lead { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; align-items: flex-start; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: .929rem; padding-top: 2px; }
.row-lead .ico { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.row-lead-icon { color: var(--ink-2); display: inline-flex; }
.row-body { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.row-title { font-weight: 500; }
.row-sub { font-size: .929rem; color: var(--ink-2); }
.row-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; }
.row-click { cursor: pointer; }
.row-click:hover { background: var(--paper-3); text-decoration: none; }
.row-selected, .row[aria-current="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.row-busy { opacity: .6; }
.row-muted, .row-muted .row-title, .row-muted .row-sub { color: var(--ink-3); }
.row-leaving { opacity: 0; }
.row-new { animation: fade-in 120ms ease-out; }
@keyframes fade-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@media (max-width: 959px) { .row { min-height: 56px; } }
@media (max-width: 479px) {
  .row-actions { grid-column: 1 / -1; justify-content: flex-start; }
  .row-actions .btn-primary { width: 100%; }
}

.section { margin-top: var(--s6); }
.section-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: var(--s2); }
.section-head h2 .count { color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 500; }
.section-head .btn-link { flex: none; }

.big-number { display: block; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.big-number:hover { text-decoration: none; border-color: var(--line-strong); }
.big-number-label { display: block; font-size: .929rem; color: var(--ink-2); }
.big-number-value { display: block; font-size: 2.286rem; line-height: 1.125; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 4px; }
.big-number-note { display: block; font-size: .929rem; color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 4px; }
.big-number-warn .big-number-value { color: var(--warn); }
.tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-top: var(--s2); }
@media (max-width: 479px) { .tiles { gap: 8px; } .tiles .big-number { padding: 12px; min-width: 0; } .big-number-value { font-size: 1.9rem; } }

/* ---------- banners, empty, skeleton ---------- */
.banner {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: var(--r-card);
  font-size: 1rem; max-width: 100%;
}
.banner .ico { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: 2px; }
.banner-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.banner-warn { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); }
.banner-danger { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }
.banner-info { background: var(--info-soft); color: var(--info); }
.banner a, .banner .btn-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; }
.banner .btn { color: var(--ink); }
.banner + .banner, .banner + .section, .banner + .label { margin-top: var(--s3); }
.banner-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }

.empty { text-align: center; padding: var(--s5); color: var(--ink-2); }
.empty .ico { width: 32px; height: 32px; color: var(--ink-3); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.empty-title { font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); }
.empty-text { font-size: .929rem; color: var(--ink-2); margin-top: 4px; max-width: 48ch; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
.empty .btn { margin-top: 12px; }

.skeleton { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.skeleton-line, .skeleton-row {
  border-radius: var(--r-ctrl);
  background: var(--paper-3);
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--paper-3) 0, var(--line) 40%, var(--paper-3) 80%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: shimmer 1.4s linear infinite;
}
.skeleton-line { height: 12px; width: 60%; }
.skeleton-row { height: 48px; border-radius: var(--r-card); }

.cal-banners:not(:empty) { margin-bottom: var(--s4); }
.cal-banners .banner + .banner { margin-top: 8px; }
.cal-banners .banner-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.cal-banners .banner-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.cal-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.cal-toolbar .cal-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.cal-toolbar .cal-range { font-size: 1.071rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 4px; white-space: nowrap; }
.cal-toolbar .cal-range .cal-range-when { color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 500; }
.cal-toolbar .cal-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.cal-toolbar .cal-tools { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.cal-seg .tab { padding: 0 12px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.cal-progress { height: 2px; margin: -4px 0 8px; background: var(--line); overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1px; }
.cal-progress::after {
  content: ""; display: block; height: 100%; width: 40%; background: var(--accent);
  animation: cal-progress 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes cal-progress { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(260%); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .cal-progress::after { animation: none; width: 100%; } }
.cal-view.is-writing .cal-grid { cursor: progress; }

/* ---------- the week / day grid ---------- */
.cal-wrap { position: relative; }
.cal-scroll {
  max-height: calc(100vh - 280px); min-height: 240px; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-card); background: var(--paper-2);
}
.cal-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 56px repeat(var(--cal-cols, 7), minmax(0, 1fr));
  grid-template-rows: 76px repeat(var(--cal-rows, 18), var(--cal-row-height, 40px));
  column-gap: 1px; background: var(--line);
  position: relative; min-width: 0;
}
.cal-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
.cal-grid:focus { outline: none; }
.cal-corner, .cal-dayhead {
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; background: var(--paper-2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.cal-corner { z-index: 6; }
.cal-dayhead {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0;
  padding: 2px 4px; text-align: center; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; border-left: 0; border-right: 0; border-top: 0;
  border-radius: 0; width: 100%;
}
button.cal-dayhead { cursor: pointer; }
button.cal-dayhead:hover { background: var(--paper-3); }
.cal-dayhead .cal-wd { font-size: .929rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2); line-height: 1.1; }
.cal-dayhead .cal-dn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 26px; height: 26px; padding: 0 6px;
  border-radius: 999px; font-size: 1.286rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1;
}
.cal-dayhead[aria-current="date"] .cal-dn { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
/* One line, ellipsised: a long block reason is in the band and the popover; the header only says "Blocked · …". */
.cal-dayhead .cal-ds { font-size: .857rem; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 500; display: block; max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.cal-dayhead.is-picked { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.cal-dayhead.is-picked:not([aria-current="date"]) .cal-dn { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.cal-dayhead .cal-ds.is-blocked { color: var(--blocked); }
.cal-dayhead .cal-ds.is-ok { color: var(--ok); }
.cal-dayhead .cal-ds .ico { width: 12px; height: 12px; vertical-align: -1px; }
.cal-dayhead:focus-visible { outline-offset: -2px; }

.cal-gutter {
  position: sticky; left: 0; z-index: 2; background: var(--paper-2);
  font-size: .857rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-3); text-align: right; padding: 3px 6px 0 0; line-height: 1;
}
.cal-gutter.is-hour { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.cal-gutter.is-half { border-top: 1px dotted var(--line); }

.cal-cell { position: relative; background: var(--paper-2); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.cal-cell.is-half { border-top-style: dotted; }
.cal-na { background: var(--paper-3); border-top: 0; }
.cal-slot { padding: 0; }
.cal-slot.is-over { background: transparent; border-top: 0; }
/* An open cell is a control whose only visual boundary is its edge: a 1 px inset ring in --line-ctrl
   (3.3:1 on white, 3.2:1 dark) marks it, where the grid's --line hairlines alone would be 1.3:1. */
.cal-open { cursor: pointer; padding: 0; font: inherit; color: inherit; border-left: 0; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 0; width: 100%; text-align: left; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-ctrl); }
.cal-open::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--accent-soft); opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--motion) ease-out; pointer-events: none; }
.cal-open:hover::before, .cal-open:focus-visible::before { opacity: .4; }
.cal-open .cal-plus { position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 6px; font-size: .857rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--accent); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.cal-open:hover .cal-plus, .cal-open:focus-visible .cal-plus { opacity: 1; }
.cal-open:focus-visible, .cal-tour:focus-visible, .cal-band-hit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -2px; z-index: 4; }
.cal-open[aria-selected="true"]::before { opacity: 1; }
.cal-open[aria-selected="true"] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent); z-index: 3; }
.cal-open[aria-selected="true"] .cal-plus { display: none; }
/* The caption is one line and may overflow its 30-minute cell; the selected cell sits above its
   neighbours (z-index 3), so the overflow paints over the next column rather than under it. */
.cal-sel-caption {
  position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 3px; z-index: 5; pointer-events: none; width: max-content; max-width: none;
  font-size: .857rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--accent); background: var(--paper-2);
  padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); white-space: nowrap;
}
.cal-open { overflow: visible; }
.cal-open.cal-last-col .cal-sel-caption { left: auto; right: 4px; }
.cal-view.is-inert .cal-open, .cal-view.is-inert .cal-tour, .cal-view.is-inert .cal-band, .cal-view.is-inert button.cal-dayhead { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .7; }

.cal-tour {
  position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; right: 2px; bottom: 2px; z-index: 2; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font: inherit;
  background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); border: 0; border-left: 3px solid var(--ok-line); border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 2px 5px; font-size: .857rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; overflow: hidden;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px;
}
.cal-tour .ico { width: 13px; height: 13px; flex: none; margin-top: 1px; }
.cal-tour .cal-ev-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.cal-view[data-cal-view="day"] .cal-tour .cal-ev-text, .cal-grid[style*="--cal-cols:1"] .cal-tour .cal-ev-text { -webkit-line-clamp: 1; }
.cal-tour.is-past { color: var(--ink-3); background: var(--paper-3); border-left-color: var(--line-strong); }
.cal-ev-name-short { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 1099px) { .cal-ev-name-full { display: none; } .cal-ev-name-short { display: inline; } }

.cal-band {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 1px; right: 1px; bottom: 0; z-index: 1; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer;
  background-color: var(--blocked-soft);
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blocked-stripe) 0 1px, transparent 1px 8px);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--blocked); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--blocked);
}
.cal-band-text {
  position: absolute; left: 6px; right: 4px; top: 3px; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none;
  font-size: .857rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px;
}
.cal-band-text .ico { width: 13px; height: 13px; flex: none; margin-top: 2px; }
.cal-band-text .cal-band-words { min-width: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.cal-band.is-tall .cal-band-text .cal-band-words { white-space: normal; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: var(--cal-lines, 2); -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.cal-band-hit { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: var(--cal-row-height, 40px); }
.cal-band-seg {
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 40px; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
}
.cal-band-seg .cal-band-words { position: absolute; left: 6px; right: 4px; top: 4px; font-size: .857rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
/* A segment that starts on the day band's first row keeps its own line under "Blocked all day". */
.cal-band-seg .cal-band-words.cal-band-words-2 { top: 20px; left: 23px; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .cal-band-seg { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .05); } }
.cal-band:hover { filter: brightness(.97); }

.cal-now, .cal-now-faint { position: relative; z-index: 4; height: 0; pointer-events: none; align-self: start; }
.cal-now { border-top: 2px solid var(--accent); }
.cal-now::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -4px; top: -4px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); }
.cal-now-faint { border-top: 2px solid var(--accent); opacity: .2; }

/* ---------- legend and lines under the grid ---------- */
.cal-foot { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: .929rem; color: var(--ink-2); }
.cal-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 16px; }
.cal-legend .cal-lg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.cal-legend .cal-sw { display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: var(--paper-2); }
.cal-legend .cal-sw-na { background: var(--paper-3); border-color: transparent; }
.cal-legend .cal-sw-tour { background: var(--ok-soft); border-color: var(--ok-line); }
.cal-legend .cal-sw-blocked { background-color: var(--blocked-soft); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blocked-stripe) 0 1px, transparent 1px 6px); border-color: var(--blocked); }
.cal-legend .ico { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
.cal-legend .cal-lg-tour .ico { color: var(--ok); }
.cal-legend .cal-lg-blocked .ico { color: var(--blocked); }
.cal-through { color: var(--ink-3); }
.cal-old { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; }
.cal-hint { color: var(--ink-3); }

.cal-skeleton { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-card); background: var(--paper-2); }
.cal-skeleton .cal-sk-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.cal-skeleton .skeleton-line { width: 100%; height: 40px; }
.cal-skeleton .skeleton-line:first-child { height: 20px; width: 70%; }
.cal-empty-card { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-card); background: var(--paper-2); }

/* ---------- popovers ---------- */
.cal-popover { width: 320px; max-width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 32px)); }
.cal-popover .popover-title { padding-right: 28px; }
.cal-popover .popover-x { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; }
.cal-popover .popover-body .muted-line { color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 6px; }
.cal-popover .popover-body a { color: var(--accent); }
.cal-popover .popover-actions .btn { height: 32px; }
.cal-popover.cal-menu { min-width: 200px; width: auto; padding: 6px; }
.cal-popover.cal-menu .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: flex-start; }
.cal-sheet-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
.cal-sheet-note { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: .929rem; margin-top: 12px; }

/* ---------- the Block sheet ---------- */
.cal-sheet .field + .field, .cal-sheet .cal-mode + .field, .cal-sheet .field + .cal-mode { margin-top: 12px; }
.cal-sheet .cal-mode { display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cal-sheet .cal-mode label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; cursor: pointer; }
.cal-sheet .cal-mode input { accent-color: var(--accent); width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 0; }
.cal-sheet .cal-mode label:has(input:disabled) { color: var(--ink-3); cursor: not-allowed; }
.cal-sheet .cal-mode-note { flex-basis: 100%; margin: 2px 0 4px; font-size: .929rem; color: var(--ink-2); }
.cal-sheet .cal-range-fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.cal-sheet .cal-chips { margin-top: 8px; }
.cal-sheet .cal-chips .chip-filter { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; }
.cal-sheet .cal-notes { list-style: none; margin: 12px 0 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: .929rem; color: var(--ink-2); }
.cal-sheet .cal-notes li { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: flex-start; }
.cal-sheet .cal-notes .ico { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-top: 2px; flex: none; }
.cal-sheet .cal-consequence { margin-top: 12px; font-size: .929rem; color: var(--ink-2); }
@media (max-width: 959px) { .cal-sheet .cal-chips .chip-filter { height: 36px; } }

/* Tour settings use the same authenticated workspace and saving feedback as calendar writes. */
.dlg.cal-settings { width: min(760px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-width: 760px; }
.cal-settings-intro { color: var(--ink-2); margin: 0 0 20px; line-height: 1.5; }
.cal-settings-form fieldset { border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; min-width: 0; }
.cal-settings-form fieldset + fieldset { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 20px; }
.cal-settings-form legend { font-weight: 650; padding: 0; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cal-settings-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.cal-settings-form .field-hint { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: .857rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.cal-settings-form .input, .cal-settings-form .select { width: 100%; }
.cal-hours { margin-top: 12px; }
.cal-hours-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 126px 44px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.cal-hours-day { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 550; }
.cal-hours-day input { width: 17px; height: 17px; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.cal-hours-state { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: .857rem; }
.cal-hours-times { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.cal-hours-times > span { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: .857rem; }
.cal-hours-times input:disabled { opacity: .45; }
@media (max-width: 599px) {
  .dlg.cal-settings { width: 100%; max-width: none; }
  .cal-settings-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cal-hours-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; }
  .cal-hours-times { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}

/* ---------- mobile agenda ---------- */
.cal-agenda-head {
  position: sticky; top: 52px; z-index: 3; background: var(--paper); padding: 4px 0 8px; margin: 0 0 4px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
}
.cal-agenda-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.cal-agenda-nav .cal-range { font-size: 1.071rem; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; flex: 1; }
.cal-agenda-nav .cal-range .cal-range-when { color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 500; }
.cal-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px; }
.cal-strip-day {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px;
  min-height: 56px; padding: 4px 0; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-ctrl); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: inherit;
}
.cal-strip-day .cal-wd { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; }
.cal-strip-day .cal-dn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px;
  font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1;
}
.cal-strip-day.is-today .cal-dn { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent); }
.cal-strip-day[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.cal-strip-day.is-past .cal-dn, .cal-strip-day.is-past .cal-wd { color: var(--ink-3); }
.cal-strip-day .cal-marks { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 6px; }
.cal-strip-day .cal-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok); }
.cal-strip-day .cal-dash { width: 10px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--blocked); }
.cal-agenda-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.cal-agenda-rows .card.rows { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.cal-arow { grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; }
.cal-arow .row-lead { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: .929rem; padding-top: 0; }
.cal-arow .row-body { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.cal-arow .row-body .ico { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.cal-arow.is-tour .row-body { color: var(--ok); }
.cal-arow.is-tour .row-body .cal-ar-sub { color: var(--ink-2); }
.cal-arow.is-blocked .row-body { color: var(--blocked); }
.cal-arow.is-open .row-body { color: var(--ink); }
.cal-arow.is-open .cal-ar-count { color: var(--ink-2); }
.cal-arow.is-inert { color: var(--ink-3); background: var(--paper-3); }
.cal-arow.is-inert .row-body, .cal-arow.is-inert .row-lead { color: var(--ink-3); }
.cal-arow .cal-chev { color: var(--ink-3); display: inline-flex; }
.cal-arow .cal-chev .ico { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.cal-arow.is-blocked .row-lead-bar { border-left: 3px solid var(--blocked); padding-left: 8px; }
.cal-arow.is-tour .row-lead-bar { border-left: 3px solid var(--ok-line); padding-left: 8px; }
.cal-fab {
  position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: calc(56px + 16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); z-index: 25;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 18px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
}
.cal-fab .ico { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
@media (max-width: 599px) { .cal-arow { grid-template-columns: 88px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; } .cal-arow .row-actions { grid-column: auto; } }
@media (max-width: 959px) {
  /* The agenda's own swipe pages days; pan-y leaves vertical scrolling to the browser and keeps a
     horizontal swipe from being read as anything else (overscroll-behavior-x: none is on html/body). */
  .cal-body { touch-action: pan-y; }
  .cal-foot { padding-bottom: 72px; }
  /* While the floating Block time… button is on screen (body.has-cal-fab, set by calendar.js), toasts
     stack above it: tab bar 56 + gap 16 + button 44 + 12 clearance. A bottom sheet still wins (toasts go to the top). */
  body.has-cal-fab:not(.has-dialog) .toast-stack { bottom: calc(128px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); }
}

/* Two tours can share one time (two model residences). Shared tours split the cell, or sit
   on the right beside the open place that is still free; the layout itself is inline. */
.cal-slot.is-shared .cal-tour{padding-left:4px;padding-right:4px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--panel, #fff)}

/* Unit availability and manual tour changes share the calendar's property context. */
.cal-action-form { display: grid; gap: 16px; }
.cal-action-intro { color: var(--ink-2); line-height: 1.55; margin: 0 0 20px; }
.cal-action-pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.cal-action-pair[hidden] { display: none; }
.cal-action-check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; }
.cal-unit-blocks { margin-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 16px; }
.cal-unit-blocks h4 { font-size: 14px; margin: 0 0 12px; }
.cal-unit-block { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 14px 0; }
.cal-unit-block:first-child { border-top: 0; }
.cal-unit-block p { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 5px 0 0; }
.cal-unit-conflict { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.cal-unit-block .cal-unit-conflict { color: var(--warn); }
.cal-action-form :disabled { opacity: .65; }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .cal-action-pair { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .cal-unit-block { flex-direction: column; } }

/* Calendar workspace: operational overview first, the precise schedule beneath it. */
.cal-hero { margin-bottom: 20px; align-items: center; }
.cal-hero-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 340px; }
.cal-hero h1 { margin: 8px 0 12px; }
.cal-hero-copy > p { max-width: 48ch; margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #DEE8FB; }
.cal-zone { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 16px; font-size: .8125rem; color: #C8D9F6; }
.cal-zone .ico { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.cal-hero .cal-hero-actions { flex: 0 1 350px; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 0; }

<script>
/*
 * Front desk shell — window.Atrium. Owner: shell. Plain ES2020 script; no modules, no deps.
 *
 * BOOT: this file registers only `window.Atrium` while it loads. The other scripts
 * (calls.js, calendar.js, leads.js) run after it and call `Atrium.register(name, module)` at
 * load. On DOMContentLoaded the shell registers its own views (today, status), paints the
 * chrome, resolves the hash route, starts polling, and fetches /api/health once. There is no
 * inline boot call in index.html. `Atrium.boot()` is idempotent.
 *
 * THE CONTRACT (CONSTRAINTS.md "The shell contract" + brief §5) — every member, in order:
 *
 *   Atrium.escapeHtml(s)      String(s ?? '') with & < > " ' escaped — the only path to innerHTML.
 *   Atrium.fmt.day(v)         'Tue, Sep 8' (+ ', 2027' when not the current NY year); 'YYYY-MM-DD'
 *                             and UTC-midnight instants render as the calendar day they encode.
 *   Atrium.fmt.dayLong(v)     'Tuesday, September 8'
 *   Atrium.fmt.time(iso)      '2:00 PM' (New York)
 *   Atrium.fmt.dateTime(iso)  'Today 2:14 PM' | 'Yesterday 6:40 PM' | 'Tomorrow 10:00 AM' | 'Tue, Sep 8, 2:14 PM'
 *                             (iso, { inSentence: true }) lower-cases the day word for use after another word
 *   Atrium.fmt.relative(iso)  'just now' | '3 min ago' | '2 hours ago' | 'yesterday' | '3 days ago' | 'Tue, Sep 1'
 *                             future: 'in 5 min' | 'in 2 hours' | 'tomorrow' | 'in 3 days' | 'Tue, Sep 15'
 *   Atrium.fmt.duration(s)    '7 min' (≥ 60 s, rounded) | '45 sec' | '—' when null. The brief's
 *                             staff wording replaces the contract's '4m 12s' example on purpose.
 *   Atrium.fmt.money(n)       a dollar sign then 4,200 (USD + n; see the build note below)
 *   Atrium.fmt.phone(s)       '(516) 990-9252' when US-shaped, else the input; 'unknown'/null → ''
 *   Atrium.fmt.nyDate(v)      'YYYY-MM-DD' in New York
 *   Atrium.fmt.nyNow()        { ymd, hour, minute, minutes, dayOfWeek } in New York right now
 *   Atrium.fmt.nyParts(iso)   the same shape for any instant (null when unparseable)
 *   Atrium.fmt.addDays(ymd,n) 'YYYY-MM-DD' arithmetic via UTC noon
 *   Atrium.fmt.dayOfWeek(ymd) 0..6, Sunday = 0
 *   Atrium.fmt.timeRange(a,b) '1:00 – 4:00 PM' | '10:30 AM – 12:00 PM'
 *   Atrium.fmt.dayPhrase(v)   'today' | 'tomorrow' | 'yesterday' | 'Thu' (next 6 days) | 'Sep 22'
 *   Atrium.fmt.duePhrase(iso) 'Due 2:00 PM' | 'Due tomorrow 10:00 AM' | 'Due Thu 11:00 AM' | 'Due Sep 22'
 *                             overdue: 'Was due 4 hours ago' | 'Was due yesterday 10:00 AM' | 'Was due Sun, Sep 6'
 *   Atrium.fmt.respondPhrase(iso) 'respond by 4:00 PM today' | 'respond by tomorrow 10:00 AM' | … | 'was due 2 hours ago'
 *   Atrium.fmt.elapsed(ms)    '14 hours' | '20 min' | '2 days' — for "oldest waiting …"
 *   Atrium.api.get(path)      parsed JSON; 401 signs out; revoked property access retires the document
 *   Atrium.api.post(path, body, { doing }) same; JSON body; throws Error(server {error}) with .status;
 *                             a failed write is remembered as state.lastWriteError (Status › For support)
 *   Atrium.gate()             session over: stop polling, no more requests, location.reload()
 *   Atrium.toast(text, { kind:'ok'|'info'|'warn'|'error', ms, actions:[{label, fn}] (max 2), sticky, key })
 *                             → { el, close(), update(text, opts) }. An action whose fn returns a promise
 *                             is busy while it settles ('Undoing…'); an Undo that resolves reads 'Undone'.
 *   Atrium.confirm(text, { title, confirmLabel, danger }) → Promise<boolean>
 *   Atrium.prompt(text, { title, placeholder, confirmLabel, required, value, maxLength }) → Promise<string|null>
 *   Atrium.dialog({ title, build(bodyEl, api), primary:{ label, danger, disabled, onClick(api) }, secondary:{ label }, onClose })
 *                             → api = { el, body, close(), setPrimary({label, disabled}), setBusy(text|null), setError(text|null), setProgress(text|null) }
 *                             one implementation behind confirm/prompt/module sheets: scrim, focus trap, Esc, return focus, mobile bottom sheet
 *   Atrium.register(name, module)   module: { title, icon, mount(rootEl), render(state), badge?(state) → number|null }
 *   Atrium.navigate(name, params?, { replace }?)   switches view, updates the hash; replace → history.replaceState
 *   Atrium.route()            { name, params } from the hash (unknown → today)
 *   Atrium.hashFor(name, params) '#/leads?phone=%2B1516…' — build links with this
 *   Atrium.state              { calls, events, calendar, leads, health, updatedAt, errors, callsError, callsConfigured,
 *                               loaded:{calls,calendar,leads}, lastGoodAt, failedRounds, notConfigured, lastWriteError }
 *                             read-only for modules
 *   Atrium.on('data', fn)     fn(state, changed:Set<'calls'|'calendar'|'leads'>) after a poll or apply that changed a
 *                             resource's data OR its failed/ok state; returns an unsubscribe function
 *   Atrium.on('route', fn)    fn(route) after each hash change
 *   Atrium.on('poll', fn)     fn(state, { changed, ok, failed }) after every poll round
 *   Atrium.on('minute', fn)   fn(state) once a minute (due groups, relative phrases)
 *   Atrium.busy(resource, promise)  marks 'calendar'|'leads' busy until settled; its polls are dropped
 *   Atrium.busyNow(resource)  boolean
 *   Atrium.apply(resource, data)    replace that resource's state from a write response; emits 'data'
 *   Atrium.refresh()          one forced poll round of all three resources (+ /api/health) → Promise
 *   Atrium.icons / Atrium.icon(name)  inline SVG strings (24px, currentColor); '' for an unknown name
 *   Atrium.property           safe property display facts from server bootstrap (legacy fixture defaults only)
 *   Atrium.normalisePhone(s)  the server's rule: 10 digits → '+1…', 11 starting 1 → '+…', other → '+digits', empty → 'unknown'
 *   Atrium.labels / Atrium.label(map, key, fallback)  §6 vocabulary; own-property lookup, humanised fallback
 *   Atrium.derive.*           windowStart, personName, displayName, displayStage, needsPerson, callBackToday,
 *                             dueTodayCount, toursOn, callRecords, callStory, todoSentence, escalationText, lossText,
 *                             summarySentence, availabilityText, moveInText, profileByPhone, profileForCall
 *   Atrium.hint(key)          localStorage one-time flag (true the first time only)
 *   Atrium.text               plural(n, one, many), list(items), truncate(s, n), humanise(s), capitalise(s),
 *                             staff(s) — 'the agent' → 'the assistant', 'residence' → 'apartment'
 *   Atrium.href               tel(phone), sms(phone), mailto(email), recording(url) — safe hrefs or null
 *   Atrium.html               chip(cls, icon, text), banner(kind, text, {actionsHtml}), empty({icon,title,text,actionHtml}),
 *                             skeletonRows(n) — small HTML builders (everything passed in is escaped here)
 *   Atrium.announce(text)     the visually hidden polite live region
 *   Atrium.escape.push(fn) / .remove(fn)   Esc handlers (popover/panel) tried newest-first before the newest toast closes
 *   Atrium.setFollowUpStatus(fu, status, { verb, button }) the §9.2 write behaviour shared by Today, Leads and Calls
 *   Atrium.boot()             idempotent; runs on DOMContentLoaded
 *
 * BUILD NOTE: scripts/build-ops.mjs splices each file in with String.prototype.replace and a
 * string replacement, so a dollar sign followed by an ampersand, another dollar sign, an
 * apostrophe, a backtick or a digit is rewritten at compose time in ANY included source (two
 * dollar signs collapse to one; dollar-ampersand becomes the include directive; dollar-apostrophe
 * duplicates the rest of the page). Even a single-quoted dollar-sign string literal trips it, so
 * money strings are built with the double-quoted USD constant below. Reviewers: grep sources.
 *
 * Polling: one round every 5 s = /api/vapi, /api/calendar, /api/leads in parallel with
 * credentials:'same-origin', cache:'no-store', accept:'application/json'. Paused while
 * document.hidden; one immediate round on visibilitychange back and on window focus. Each
 * resource keeps its own JSON signature (generatedAt/note excluded); a response that lands
 * after apply() bumped that resource's seq is discarded; a resource with a write in flight is
 * skipped. Two rounds in a row with no success turn the status cluster amber; errors sit in
 * state.errors[resource] and appear as banners inside views and under Status › For support.
 */
(function () {
'use strict'

const LEGACY_TIME_ZONE = 'America/New_York'
const databaseMode = window.ATRIUM_RUNTIME_MODE === 'postgres'
// Snapshot the rendered account once. A different tab can replace the shared login cookie.
const legacyTenantId = databaseMode ? null : window.ATRIUM_ACCOUNT && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(window.ATRIUM_ACCOUNT, 'tenantId')
  ? window.ATRIUM_ACCOUNT.tenantId : 'legacy'
const ID_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$/
const PERMISSIONS = ['read', 'operate', 'configure', 'manage_members', 'manage_organization']
let documentScope = null
let displayProperty = null
let documentAccessIssue = null
function permissionAllowed(permission) {
  return !documentAccessIssue && (!databaseMode || documentScope.permissions.includes(permission))
}
function displayText(value, max = 200) { return typeof value === 'string' && value.length <= max && !/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(value) }
function scopeIdentity(value) {
  return value && typeof value === 'object' && typeof value.organizationId === 'string' && typeof value.propertyId === 'string'
    && ID_PATTERN.test(value.organizationId) && ID_PATTERN.test(value.propertyId)
}
function validatedBootstrap(value) {
  if (!scopeIdentity(value) || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.configurationVersion) || value.configurationVersion < 1
    || !displayText(value.permissionVersion) || !value.permissionVersion
    || !Array.isArray(value.permissions) || !value.permissions.includes('read')
    || value.permissions.some(p => !PERMISSIONS.includes(p)) || new Set(value.permissions).size !== value.permissions.length
    || !displayText(value.buildingName) || !value.buildingName.trim()
    || !displayText(value.locationLabel ?? '', 300) || !value.hours || typeof value.hours !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value.hours)) throw new Error('Invalid property bootstrap')
  const hours = {}
  for (const [day, range] of Object.entries(value.hours)) {
    if (!/^[0-6]$/.test(day) || !Array.isArray(range) || range.length !== 2
      || range.some(n => typeof n !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 24) || range[1] <= range[0]) throw new Error('Invalid property hours')

    calendarSaving: !state.loaded.calendar ? null : (savingOff(calStore) ? (kvUnreachable(calStore) ? 'temp' : 'off') : 'on'),
    recordings: !state.loaded.calls ? null : (state.callsConfigured === false ? 'off' : (state.callsError ? 'down' : 'on')),

const toasts = []

  if (o.key) for (const t of toasts.slice()) if (t.key === o.key) t.close()

  const el = document.createElement('div')
  el.className = `toast toast-${kind}`
  el.setAttribute('role', kind === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status')

  const ms = o.sticky ? Infinity : Math.max(Number(o.ms) || TOAST_MS[kind], actions.length ? 8000 : 0)

    el.innerHTML = `<span class="toast-icon">${icon(TOAST_ICON[kind])}</span><span class="toast-text">${esc(t)}</span>` +
      (acts.length ? `<span class="toast-actions">${acts.map((a, i) => `<button type="button" class="btn-link toast-action" data-i="${i}">${esc(a.label)}</button>`).join('')}</span>` : '') +
      `<button type="button" class="toast-close btn-icon" aria-label="Close">${icon('x')}</button>`
    el.querySelector('.toast-close').addEventListener('click', close)
    el.querySelectorAll('.toast-action').forEach((b) => {
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {

        const isUndo = /^undo$/i.test(String(a.label))

    clearTimeout(timer)
    const i = toasts.indexOf(handle); if (i >= 0) toasts.splice(i, 1)
    const hadFocus = el.contains(document.activeElement)
    if (el.isConnected) el.remove()

    if (hadFocus) {
      const next = toasts.length ? toasts[toasts.length - 1].el : null
      const target = (next && (next.querySelector('.toast-action') || next.querySelector('.toast-close'))) || document.querySelector('.view:not([hidden]) h1')

  toasts.push(handle)

function todoSentence(fu, profile, s) {
  const p = profile || profileByPhone(s || state, fu.phone) || { phone: fu.phone, name: null }
  const name = personName(p)
  const kind = String(fu.kind ?? '')
  const today = nyNow().ymd
  const verbFor = (ch) => label(labels.channelVerb, ch, 'Call')
  const sourceBooking = fu.source?.version === 2 && fu.source.kind === 'booking' ? fu.source.booking : null
  const hasBookingSource = fu.source?.version === 2
  const unitKey = value => String(value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()
  const exactBooking = sourceBooking && arr(p.bookings).find(b => b && b.status === 'confirmed'
    && b.slotId === sourceBooking.slotId && toTime(b.startsAt) != null && toTime(b.startsAt) === toTime(sourceBooking.startsAt)
    && unitKey(b.unitId) === unitKey(sourceBooking.unitId))

  const bookingOn = (ymd) => hasBookingSource ? exactBooking || null

  const tourPhrase = (b) => `${fmt.time(b.startsAt)} tour${b.unitId ? ` of apartment ${b.unitId}` : ''}`
  const dayWord = (ymd) => { const d = daysBetween(today, ymd); return d === 0 ? "today's" : d === 1 ? "tomorrow's" : `${WD_LONG[dayOfWeek(ymd)]}'s` }
  const reason = String(fu.reason ?? '')

  if (kind === 'confirm_tour') {

    else if ((m = /still coming at (\d{1,2}:\d{2} [AP]M)(?: to see (\S+?))?\.$/.exec(reason))) after = ` to confirm their ${m[1]} tour${m[2] ? ` of apartment ${m[2]}` : ''}`
    else after = ' to confirm their tour'

    after = ` to check whether they attended the tour${unit ? ` of apartment ${unit}` : ''}. If so, ask how it went and whether they want to apply.`
  } else if (kind === 'priced_out_watch') {
    verb = verbFor(fu.channel); before = `${verb} `
    const range = p.signals && p.signals.budgetRange && budgetText(p.signals.budgetRange.value)
    const budget = p.signals && p.signals.budget && p.signals.budget.value
    if (range) after = ` if anything in their ${range} range opens up`
    else if (budget != null && !isNaN(Number(budget))) after = ` if anything under ${fmt.money(budget)} opens up`
    else if ((m = /priced out \((.+?)\)/.exec(reason))) after = ` if anything in their range opens up (${text.staff(m[1])})`
    else after = ' if anything in their range opens up'
  } else if (kind === 'nurture') {
    after = " — interested but didn't book. Offer a tour again."
  } else if (kind === 'callback') {

      verb = 'Review'; before = 'Review the emergency reported by '

    else { before = 'Get an email address for '; after = ' so the tour confirmation can go out' }

    after = reason ? ` — ${text.staff(reason)}` : ''

}

  const allTwenty = arr(s.calls).length >= 20 && arr(s.calls).every((c) => (toTime(c.startedAt) ?? 0) >= wsT)

  const summary = (title, detail, tone = '') => ({ title, detail: detail + history, tone: history && tone === 'is-ok' ? '' : tone })
  if (s.notConfigured) return summary('This workspace needs setup.', 'Ask Atrium support to restore access.', 'is-warn')
  if (failed.length) return summary(loaded.length ? 'Some workspace information is unavailable.' : 'Workspace information is unavailable.',
    `Couldn’t refresh ${text.list(failed.map(name => labels[name]))}. Some information may be missing or out of date.`, 'is-warn')

  if (s.callsError) return summary('Call history needs attention.', 'Recent recordings and transcripts could not be refreshed. See the details below.', 'is-warn')
  const stores = ['leads', 'calendar'].filter(name => s.loaded[name]).map(name => s[name] && s[name].store)
  if (stores.some(store => store && store.durable === false) && !(isDemo && !isPersistentDemo)) {

  }
  if (!isDemo && s.loaded.calls && s.callsConfigured === false) {

  }

  if (pending.length) return summary(loaded.length ? 'Still checking this workspace…' : 'Checking this workspace…',

  for (const l of document.querySelectorAll('link[data-font-swap]')) l.media = 'all'
  register('today', todayView)
  register('status', statusView)
  paintChrome()

<script>

function buildModel(s, opts) {

  const bookings = c ? arr(c.bookings).filter((b) => b && b.slotId != null) : []

      i, name: String(b.prospectName ?? '').trim(),
      unitId: b.unitId != null && b.unitId !== '' ? String(b.unitId) : null,

      booking: bookings.find((x) => b.externalId ? x.externalId === b.externalId : String(x.slotId) === String(raw.slotId) && String(x.prospectName ?? '').trim() === String(b.prospectName ?? '').trim()) || null,
    }))

      id: String(raw.slotId), date, startsAt: raw.startsAt, endsAt: raw.endsAt, startMin, endMin, status,
      capacity: Number(raw.capacity) > 0 ? Number(raw.capacity) : 1, tours, unavailableReason: String(raw.reason || 'Not offered'),
      rawReason: status === 'blocked' ? String((raw.block && raw.block.reason) ?? '') : '',

  const date = calendarDate(opts.date) ? opts.date : today
  const ws = weekStart(date)
  const days = view === 'week' ? [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => fmt.addDays(ws, i)) : [date]

/** The lead join for a booked slot (never prospectPhone — contract §5.4). */
function tourInfo(s, m, sl) {

  const candidates = []

    name: sl.name || (profile && profile.name) || 'Tour', profile, phone: profile && profile.phone !== 'unknown' ? profile.phone : null,
    email: (profile && profile.email) || null, unitId: sl.unitId != null ? sl.unitId : (lb && lb.unitId != null ? String(lb.unitId) : null),

  const [sm, sd] = monthDayNoYear(s).split(' '), [em, ed] = monthDayNoYear(e).split(' ')
  const ey = e.slice(0, 4), cy = m.today.slice(0, 4)
  let range = sm === em && s.slice(0, 4) === ey ? `${sm} ${sd} – ${ed}` : `${sm} ${sd} – ${em} ${ed}`
  if (ey !== cy) range += `, ${ey}`
  const when = s === m.firstWeek ? 'This week' : s === fmt.addDays(m.firstWeek, 7) ? 'Next week' : ''
  const [lsm, lsd] = longMonthDay(s).split(' '), [lem, led] = longMonthDay(e).split(' ')
  const longRange = lsm === lem ? `${lsm} ${lsd} to ${led}` : `${lsm} ${lsd} to ${lem} ${led}`
  return { when, range, live: `Showing ${when ? `${when.toLowerCase()}, ` : ''}${longRange}${ey !== cy ? `, ${ey}` : ''}` }
}

/** Screen-reader label of a grid item. */
function itemLabel(m, it) {
  const day = fmt.dayLong(it.ymd)
  if (it.kind === 'open') return `${day}, ${fmt.time(it.slot.startsAt)}, open. ${cal.slotBlocksFail ? 'Block this day' : 'Block this time'}`
  if (it.kind === 'tour') return `${day}, ${fmt.time(it.slot.startsAt)}, tour with ${it.slot.name || 'a caller'}${it.slot.unitId ? `, apartment ${it.slot.unitId}` : ''}, confirmed`
  if (it.kind === 'band') return `${day}, blocked ${it.slots.length > 1 ? toRange(it.first.startsAt, it.last.endsAt) : fmt.time(it.first.startsAt)}${it.reason ? `, ${it.reason}` : ''}. Reopen`
  return `${day}, blocked all day${it.reason ? `, ${it.reason}` : ''}. Reopen ${longDay(it.ymd)}`
}

/** The polite live region, never more than once per 2 s (the latest sentence wins). */
function say(msg) {
  const now = Date.now(), wait = 2000 - (now - cal.lastLive)
  clearTimeout(cal.liveTimer)
  if (wait <= 0) { cal.lastLive = now; A.announce(msg); return }
  cal.liveTimer = setTimeout(() => { cal.lastLive = Date.now(); A.announce(msg) }, wait)
}

/** Counts describe only the selected, successfully loaded property-local range. */
function summaryModel(s, m) {
  if (!m.loaded) return null
  const inRange = instant => { const date = fmt.nyDate(instant); return date && date >= m.range.from && date <= m.range.to }
  const tours = new Map()
  for (const booking of m.bookings) {
    if (!booking.externalId || (booking.status && booking.status !== 'confirmed') || !inRange(booking.startsAt)
      || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(booking.endsAt)) || Date.parse(booking.endsAt) <= Date.parse(booking.startsAt)) continue
    tours.set(booking.externalId, booking)
  }
  // A supplied interval is authoritative, including blocks created in an older timezone.
  const overlaps = block => {
    const start = Date.parse(block.startsAt), end = Date.parse(block.endsAt)
    if (Number.isFinite(start) && Number.isFinite(end) && end > start) {
      const first = fmt.nyDate(start), last = fmt.nyDate(end - 1)
      return first && last && first <= m.range.to && last >= m.range.from
    }
    const date = isYmd(block.target) ? block.target : /^slot-(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})T/.exec(String(block.target))?.[1]
    return date && date >= m.range.from && date <= m.range.to
  }
  const building = new Set(m.blocks.filter(overlaps).map(block => block.target)).size
  const unit = new Set(arr(s.calendar?.unitBlocks).filter(block => block && !block.removedAt && overlaps(block)).map(block => block.id)).size
  const open = new Set(m.slots.filter(slot => slot.status === 'open' && slot.date >= m.range.from && slot.date <= m.range.to).map(slot => slot.id)).size
  return { tours: tours.size, open, building, unit, holds: building + unit }
}

'Shared tours allowed' : 'One tour per apartment'}</strong></div><div><span>Book ahead</span><strong>${settings.bookingWindowDays == null ? 'No advance limit' : `${esc(settings.bookingWindowDays)} days`}</strong></div></div>`

const navBtn = (action, label, disabled) => `<button type="button" class="btn-icon" data-action="${action}" data-key="${action}" aria-label="${esc(label)}"${disabled ? ' aria-disabled="true"' : ''}>${A.icon(action === 'prev' ? 'chevron-left' : 'chevron-right')}</button>`
const dis = (on) => (on ? ' aria-disabled="true"' : '')

function toolbarHtml(m) {
  const rt = rangeText(m)
  const unit = m.view === 'week' ? 'week' : 'day'
  const prevOff = Number(m.date.slice(0, 4)) <= 1900
  const nextOff = Number(m.date.slice(0, 4)) >= 9998
  const navigation = m.mobile ? '' : `<div class="cal-nav">${navBtn('prev', `Previous ${unit}`, prevOff)}<button type="button" class="btn" data-action="today" data-key="today">Today</button>${navBtn('next', `Next ${unit}`, nextOff)}</div>`

'<button type="button" class="btn" data-action="today" data-key="today">Today</button>' : `<div class="seg cal-seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Layout"><button type="button" class="tab" role="radio" aria-checked="${m.view === 'week' ? 'true' : 'false'}" data-action="view-week" data-key="view-week">Week</button><button type="button" class="tab" role="radio" aria-checked="${m.view === 'day' ? 'true' : 'false'}" data-action="view-day" data-key="view-day">Day</button></div>`
  return `<div class="cal-schedule-heading"><div><span class="section-kicker">${m.mobile ? 'One day at a time' : 'Schedule overview'}</span>${heading}</div><div class="cal-tools">${layout}<button type="button" class="btn" data-action="goto" data-key="goto">Go to date</button></div></div>` +
    `<div class="cal-toolbar">${navigation}<p class="cal-window-note">${m.loaded ? `Showing ${esc(fmt.monthDay(m.range.from))}${m.range.to !== m.range.from ? ` – ${esc(fmt.monthDay(m.range.to))}` : ''}` : 'Loading selected dates'} · ${esc(A.property.timeZoneLabel)}</p></div>` +

function itemHtml(m, it, col) {
  const r = it.row, isHour = (m.minM + r * m.stepMin) % 60 === 0
  const place = `grid-row:${r + 2} / span ${it.span};grid-column:${col}`
  const common = `data-key="${esc(it.key)}" data-date="${esc(it.ymd)}" data-row="${r}" data-col="${col - 2}" data-kind="${it.kind}"`
  if (it.kind === 'open') {
    const sel = cal.sel && cal.sel.date === it.ymd && cal.sel.slotIds.includes(it.slot.id)
    let caption = ''
    if (sel && cal.sel.slotIds[0] === it.slot.id) {
      const first = m.byId.get(cal.sel.slotIds[0]), last = m.byId.get(cal.sel.slotIds[cal.sel.slotIds.length - 1])
      if (first && last) caption = `<span class="cal-sel-caption" aria-hidden="true">${esc(fmt.timeRange(first.startsAt, last.endsAt))} · ${esc(plural(cal.sel.slotIds.length, 'time'))}</span>`
    }
    const lastCol = col === m.days.length + 1 && m.days.length > 1 // the caption hangs leftwards there, or the scroll box would clip it
    return `<button type="button" class="cal-cell cal-open${isHour ? '' : ' is-half'}${lastCol ? ' cal-last-col' : ''}" role="gridcell" aria-colindex="${col}" ${common} data-slot="${esc(it.slot.id)}" tabindex="-1" aria-label="${esc(itemLabel(m, it))}" aria-selected="${sel ? 'true' : 'false'}" style="${place}">${caption}${cal.slotBlocksFail ? '' : '<span class="cal-plus" aria-hidden="true">+ Block</span>'}</button>`
  }
  if (it.kind === 'tour') {
    const sl = it.slot, past = (Date.parse(sl.startsAt) || 0) < Date.now()
    const over = m.dayBlocks.has(it.ymd)
    const full = m.view === 'day'
      ? `${sl.name || 'Tour'}${sl.unitId ? ` · apartment ${sl.unitId}` : ''} · ${fmt.timeRange(sl.startsAt, sl.endsAt)}`
      : `${clock(sl.startsAt)} ${shortName(sl.name)}${sl.unitId ? ` · ${sl.unitId}` : ''}`
    const short = m.view === 'day' ? full : `${clock(sl.startsAt)} ${firstName(sl.name)}`
    // Tours sharing one time split the cell; a lone tour on a time with a place still open
    // keeps to the right so the open cell beside it can be clicked.
    const lay = it.lanes > 1 ? `;width:${100 / it.lanes}%;justify-self:start;transform:translateX(${it.lane * 100}%)` : ''
    return `<div class="cal-cell cal-slot${isHour ? '' : ' is-half'}${over ? ' is-over' : ''}${sl.shared ? ' is-shared' : ''}" role="presentation" style="${place}${lay}">` +
      `<button type="button" class="cal-tour${past ? ' is-past' : ''}" role="gridcell" aria-colindex="${col}" ${common} data-slot="${esc(sl.id)}" tabindex="-1" aria-label="${esc(itemLabel(m, it))}">${ico('person')}<span class="cal-ev-text"><span class="cal-ev-name-full">${esc(full)}</span><span class="cal-ev-name-short">${esc(short)}</span></span></button></div>`
  }
  // band or dayband
  const n = it.span
  const topSegs = it.kind === 'dayband' ? it.segs.filter((sg) => sg.row === 0) : []
  const nextSeg = it.kind === 'dayband' ? it.segs.find((sg) => sg.row > 0) : null
  const linesFor = (rows) => Math.max(2, Math.min(6, Math.floor((rows * m.rowHeight - 8) / 15)))
  // A segment on the band's first row takes the second line, so the day's own label keeps to one.
  const lines = topSegs.length ? 1 : (nextSeg ? Math.max(1, Math.min(linesFor(n), linesFor(nextSeg.row))) : linesFor(n))
  let words
  if (it.kind === 'dayband') words = `Blocked all day${it.reason ? ` · ${it.reason}` : ''}`
  else if (it.slots.length > 1) words = `Blocked ${fmt.timeRange(it.first.startsAt, it.last.endsAt)}${it.reason ? (n >= 2 ? '\n' : ' · ') + it.reason : ''}`
  else words = `Blocked${it.reason ? ` · ${it.reason}` : ''}`
  // A slot's own block inside a day band is its own line — its time, then its own reason — never the day's.
  const segWords = (sg) => { const a = sg.slots[0], b = sg.slots[sg.slots.length - 1]; return `${sg.slots.length > 1 ? fmt.timeRange(a.startsAt, b.endsAt) : fmt.time(a.startsAt)} · ${sg.slot.reason || 'Blocked'}` }
  let hits = ''
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) hits += i === 0
    ? `<div class="cal-band-hit" role="gridcell" aria-colindex="${col}" aria-rowspan="${n}" tabindex="-1" aria-label="${esc(itemLabel(m, it))}" style="top:0"></div>`
    : `<div class="cal-band-hit" aria-hidden="true" style="top:${i * m.rowHeight}px"></div>`
  const segs = it.kind === 'dayband' ? it.segs.map((sg) => `<div class="cal-band-seg" aria-hidden="true" style="top:${sg.row * m.rowHeight}px;height:${sg.span * m.rowHeight}px" data-seg="${esc(sg.slot.id)}"><span class="cal-band-words${sg.row === 0 ? ' cal-band-words-2' : ''}">${esc(segWords(sg))}</span></div>`).join('') : ''
  const slotList = it.slots.map((x) => x.id).join(' ')
  return `<div class="cal-cell cal-slot${isHour ? '' : ' is-half'}" role="presentation" style="${place}">` +
    `<div class="cal-band${n >= 2 ? ' is-tall' : ''}" ${common} data-slots="${esc(slotList)}" style="--cal-lines:${lines}"><span class="cal-band-text">${ico('slash')}<span class="cal-band-words">${esc(words).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</span></span>${segs}${hits}</div></div>`
}

function gridHtml(m) {

    else out += `<div class="${cls}" ${common} aria-label="${esc(label_)}">${inner}</div>`

  const starts = m.dayModels.map((d) => { const map = new Map(); for (const it of d.items) { if (!map.has(it.row)) map.set(it.row, []); map.get(it.row).push(it) } return map })

    m.dayModels.forEach((d, i) => {

}

function nowHtml(m) {
  const col = m.days.indexOf(m.today)
  const nowMin = fmt.nyNow().minutes
  if (col < 0 || nowMin < m.minM || nowMin >= m.maxM) return ''
  const row = Math.floor((nowMin - m.minM) / m.stepMin), off = Math.round(((nowMin - m.minM) % m.stepMin) / m.stepMin * m.rowHeight)
  return `<div class="cal-now-faint" aria-hidden="true" style="grid-row:${row + 2};grid-column:2 / -1;transform:translateY(${off}px)"></div>` +
    `<div class="cal-now" aria-hidden="true" style="grid-row:${row + 2};grid-column:${col + 2};transform:translateY(${off}px)"></div>`
}

function agendaHtml(m) {

  const rows = []
